findings.desc: computeWriteSet includes allowedTest but plan.md, checklist context, and userSees declare only allowedModify+allowedCreate: plan.md says dedupe(allowedModify++allowedCreate); scope-check feature says unions allowedModify+allowedCreate paths; userSees says unions a contract allowedModify+allowedCreate — none mention allowedTest. The implementation unions all three. Behavior is conservative (aligns with never-under-flag philosophy) and the verificationEvidence note acknowledges it, but the declared spec surface and implementation are inconsistent. If Story 2 callers rely on the plan-stated contract (allowedModify+allowedCreate only), the underdeclaration may cause confusion or test-file paths being unexpectedly included in overlap verdicts.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: computeWriteSet now unions only allowedModify + allowedCreate (allowedTest excluded — it is an allowed-to-touch permission, not a declared write target), matching plan.md and avoiding over-flagging test globs.

findings.desc: smoke-gap: parallel-decomposition-overlap-smoke.ts has no assertions for children-vs-subtree, overlapping subtree-vs-subtree, or children-vs-children interactions — the three non-literal wildcard combinations that use the tier-2 heuristic branch; if entriesOverlap is modified later these regressions have no coverage
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: smoke extended from 20 to 32 assertions — added children-vs-children (same + sibling), children-vs-subtree nested, subtree-vs-subtree (nested + sibling), shared-prefix children cases, empty-dir rejection, and allowedTest-exclusion.

findings.desc: [Codex host P1] entriesOverlap under-flagged shared-prefix collisions for children globs: src/* vs src/csv/* and src/csv/* vs a deep literal (src/csv/impl/parser.ts) were not flagged, but spec 4.2 tier-2 requires conservative shared-directory-prefix flagging. Two stories could pass PLAN->DEV with intersecting scopes.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed (Codex P1): entriesOverlap rewritten to conservative scope-directory nesting for any wildcard-involved pair — src/* vs src/csv/* and src/csv/* vs src/csv/impl/parser.ts now flag overlap; literal-vs-literal stays tier-1 exact. Verified by new smoke assertions.

findings.desc: [Codex host P1] validateWriteSetGrammar accepted empty-directory wildcards (/* and /**) because dir is empty after slice; classifyBroadness(/*) reported narrow, so an effectively repo-wide scope could slip through both the grammar and broadness checks.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed (Codex P1): validateWriteSetGrammar now rejects empty-directory wildcards (/*, /**); classifyBroadness treats an empty/root wildcard dir as BROAD. Verified by new smoke assertions.

findings.desc: concept-cleanup: smoke section-1 comment (line 25) says computeWriteSet unions allowedModify + allowedCreate + allowedTest — describing the pre-F-001 three-field union. Post-fix the engine unions only allowedModify + allowedCreate (allowedTest excluded). The assertion still passes because the fixture places parser.test.ts in allowedCreate, not allowedTest, so the behavior is correct. But the comment is stale/misleading: it contradicts the corrected contract (plan.md, F-001 resolution, section-10 comment). Future readers of section 1 will believe allowedTest is included. File: packages/main/src/tasks/parallel-decomposition-overlap-smoke.ts line 25.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: smoke line-1 comment corrected to "allowedModify + allowedCreate, deduped (allowedTest excluded)" matching the F-001 fix.

findings.desc: [Codex host P2] entriesOverlap under-flagged single-segment root literals: globsOverlap([docs],[docs/*]) returned false because the literal was reduced to its parent dir. Fixed by comparing the literal full path (e.dir) against the wildcard dir.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed: entriesOverlap simplified to nest e.dir (literal full path vs wildcard dir) both ways; docs vs docs/* and docs vs docs/** now overlap, README.md vs README/* stays disjoint, and the F-003 deep-literal case (src/csv/* vs src/csv/impl/parser.ts) still flags. Removed now-dead dirname(). smoke 35 assertions.

findings.desc: [Codex host P1] the public contract parallel-decomposition.ts still exports computeWriteSet/globsOverlap as NotImplemented stubs; the real logic is in the sidecar parallel-decomposition-overlap.ts. By design for the contract-first file-split: Story 1 cannot edit the frozen contract (out of scope); the re-export reconciliation is Story 5 (serial integration).
